trial_court: District Judge, Family Court, Gulbarga - M.C.No.209/2013
case_name: Ashwathnarayan S/O Sabareddy vs Sujatha W/O Ashwathnarayan
facts_of_case: Respondent filed petition under Section 13(1)(ia)(ib) of Hindu Marriage Act, praying for divorce. Appellant claimed respondent was not cooperative and had suppressed medical condition.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking divorce to prove that the other party has not been cooperative and has led a married life for a period of four years.
legal_principles.held: It is submitted by the counsels that the respondent-wife was not cooperative and would avoid cohabitation and consummation of the marriage during the said period.

legal_principles.principle: A party seeking divorce must prove that the other party has not been cooperative and has led a married life for a period of four years.
legal_principles.held: The brief facts of the case is that the respondent filed a petition under Section 13(1)(ia)(ib) of Hindu Marriage Act, 1956, praying for a decree of divorce to dissolve the marriage solemnized on 04.05.2007

keywords: Latin maxim: Nemo judex in causa sua
